48	/** Transcript JSON may deserialize Write tool `content` as a nested object — LRU needs strings. */
49	function coerceToolContentToString(value: unknown): string {
50	  if (typeof value === 'string') return value
51	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return ''
52	  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value)
53	  return String(value)
54	}

56	/**
57	 * Checks if the result should be considered successful based on the last message.
58	 * Returns true if:
59	 * - Last message is assistant with text/thinking content
60	 * - Last message is user with only tool_result blocks
61	 * - Last message is the user prompt but the API completed with end_turn
62	 *   (model chose to emit no content blocks)
63	 */
64	export function isResultSuccessful(
65	  message: Message | undefined,
66	  stopReason: string | null = null,
67	): message is Message {
68	  if (!message) return false
69	
70	  if (message.type === 'assistant') {
71	    const content = message.message.content
72	    const lastContent = Array.isArray(content) ? last(content) : undefined
73	    return (
74	      lastContent?.type === 'text' ||
75	      lastContent?.type === 'thinking' ||
76	      lastContent?.type === 'redacted_thinking'
77	    )
78	  }
79	
80	  if (message.type === 'user') {
81	    // Check if all content blocks are tool_result type
82	    const content = message.message.content
83	    if (
84	      Array.isArray(content) &&
85	      content.length > 0 &&
86	      content.every(block => 'type' in block && block.type === 'tool_result')
87	    ) {
88	      return true
89	    }
90	  }
91	
92	  // Carve-out: API completed (message_delta set stop_reason) but yielded
93	  // no assistant content — last(messages) is still this turn's prompt.
94	  // claude.ts:2026 recognizes end_turn-with-zero-content-blocks as
95	  // legitimate and passes through without throwing. Observed on
96	  // task_notification drain turns: model returns stop_reason=end_turn,
97	  // outputTokens=4, textContentLength=0 — it saw the subagent result
98	  // and decided nothing needed saying. Without this, QueryEngine emits
99	  // error_during_execution with errors[] = the entire process's
100	  // accumulated logError() buffer. Covers both string-content and
101	  // text-block-content user prompts, and any other non-passing shape.
102	  return stopReason === 'end_turn'
103	}

105	// Track last sent time for tool progress messages per tool use ID
106	// Keep only the last 100 entries to prevent unbounded growth
107	const MAX_TOOL_PROGRESS_TRACKING_ENTRIES = 100
108	const TOOL_PROGRESS_THROTTLE_MS = 30000
109	const toolProgressLastSentTime = new Map<string, number>()

111	export function* normalizeMessage(message: Message): Generator<SDKMessage> {
112	  switch (message.type) {
113	    case 'assistant':
114	      for (const _ of normalizeMessages([message])) {
115	        // Skip empty messages (e.g., "(no content)") that shouldn't be output to SDK
116	        if (!isNotEmptyMessage(_)) {
117	          continue
118	        }
119	        yield {
120	          type: 'assistant',
121	          message: _.message,
122	          parent_tool_use_id: null,
123	          session_id: getSessionId(),
124	          uuid: _.uuid,
125	          error: _.error,
126	        }
127	      }
128	      return
129	    case 'progress': {
130	      const progressData = message.data as { type: string; message: Message; elapsedTimeSeconds: number; taskId: string }
131	      if (
132	        progressData.type === 'agent_progress' ||
133	        progressData.type === 'skill_progress'
134	      ) {
135	        for (const _ of normalizeMessages([progressData.message])) {
136	          switch (_.type) {
137	            case 'assistant':
138	              // Skip empty messages (e.g., "(no content)") that shouldn't be output to SDK
139	              if (!isNotEmptyMessage(_)) {
140	                break
141	              }
142	              yield {
143	                type: 'assistant',
144	                message: _.message,
145	                parent_tool_use_id: message.parentToolUseID as string,
146	                session_id: getSessionId(),
147	                uuid: _.uuid,
148	                error: _.error,
149	              }
150	              break
151	            case 'user':
152	              yield {
153	                type: 'user',
154	                message: _.message,
155	                parent_tool_use_id: message.parentToolUseID as string,
156	                session_id: getSessionId(),
157	                uuid: _.uuid,
158	                timestamp: _.timestamp as string | undefined,
159	                isSynthetic: _.isMeta || _.isVisibleInTranscriptOnly,
160	                tool_use_result: _.mcpMeta
161	                  ? { content: _.toolUseResult, ...(_.mcpMeta as Record<string, unknown>) }
162	                  : _.toolUseResult,
163	              }
164	              break
165	          }
166	        }
167	      } else if (
168	        progressData.type === 'bash_progress' ||
169	        progressData.type === 'powershell_progress'
170	      ) {
171	        // Filter bash progress to send only one per minute
172	        // Only emit for Claude Code Remote for now
173	        if (
174	          !isEnvTruthy(process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE) &&
175	          !process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_CONTAINER_ID
176	        ) {
177	          break
178	        }
179	
180	        // Use parentToolUseID as the key since toolUseID changes for each progress message
181	        const trackingKey = message.parentToolUseID as string
182	        const now = Date.now()
183	        const lastSent = toolProgressLastSentTime.get(trackingKey) || 0
184	        const timeSinceLastSent = now - lastSent
185	
186	        // Send if at least 30 seconds have passed since last update
187	        if (timeSinceLastSent >= TOOL_PROGRESS_THROTTLE_MS) {
188	          // Remove oldest entry if we're at capacity (LRU eviction)
189	          if (
190	            toolProgressLastSentTime.size >= MAX_TOOL_PROGRESS_TRACKING_ENTRIES
191	          ) {
192	            const firstKey = toolProgressLastSentTime.keys().next().value
193	            if (firstKey !== undefined) {
194	              toolProgressLastSentTime.delete(firstKey)
195	            }
196	          }
197	
198	          toolProgressLastSentTime.set(trackingKey, now)
199	          yield {
200	            type: 'tool_progress',
201	            tool_use_id: message.toolUseID as string,
202	            tool_name:
203	              progressData.type === 'bash_progress' ? 'Bash' : 'PowerShell',
204	            parent_tool_use_id: message.parentToolUseID as string,
205	            elapsed_time_seconds: progressData.elapsedTimeSeconds,
206	            task_id: progressData.taskId,
207	            session_id: getSessionId(),
208	            uuid: message.uuid,
209	          }
210	        }
211	      }
212	      break
213	    }
214	    case 'user':
215	      for (const _ of normalizeMessages([message])) {
216	        yield {
217	          type: 'user',
218	          message: _.message,
219	          parent_tool_use_id: null,
220	          session_id: getSessionId(),
221	          uuid: _.uuid,
222	          timestamp: _.timestamp as string | undefined,
223	          isSynthetic: _.isMeta || _.isVisibleInTranscriptOnly,
224	          tool_use_result: _.mcpMeta
225	            ? { content: _.toolUseResult, ...(_.mcpMeta as Record<string, unknown>) }
226	            : _.toolUseResult,
227	        }
228	      }
229	      return
230	    default:
231	    // yield nothing
232	  }
233	}

235	export async function* handleOrphanedPermission(
236	  orphanedPermission: OrphanedPermission,
237	  tools: Tools,
238	  mutableMessages: Message[],
239	  processUserInputContext: ProcessUserInputContext,
240	): AsyncGenerator<SDKMessage, void, unknown> {
241	  const persistSession = !isSessionPersistenceDisabled()
242	  const { permissionResult, assistantMessage } = orphanedPermission
243	  const toolUseID = (permissionResult as { toolUseID?: string }).toolUseID
244	
245	  if (!toolUseID) {
246	    return
247	  }
248	
249	  const content = assistantMessage.message.content
250	  let toolUseBlock: ToolUseBlock | undefined
251	  if (Array.isArray(content)) {
252	    for (const block of content) {
253	      if (block.type === 'tool_use' && block.id === toolUseID) {
254	        toolUseBlock = block as ToolUseBlock
255	        break
256	      }
257	    }
258	  }
259	
260	  if (!toolUseBlock) {
261	    return
262	  }
263	
264	  const toolName = toolUseBlock.name
265	  const toolInput = toolUseBlock.input
266	
267	  const toolDefinition = findToolByName(tools, toolName)
268	  if (!toolDefinition) {
269	    return
270	  }
271	
272	  // Create ToolUseBlock with the updated input if permission was allowed
273	  let finalInput = toolInput
274	  if (permissionResult.behavior === 'allow') {
275	    const allowResult = permissionResult as { behavior: 'allow'; updatedInput?: unknown }
276	    if (allowResult.updatedInput !== undefined) {
277	      finalInput = allowResult.updatedInput
278	    } else {
279	      logForDebugging(
280	        `Orphaned permission for ${toolName}: updatedInput is undefined, falling back to original tool input`,
281	        { level: 'warn' },
282	      )
283	    }
284	  }
285	  const finalToolUseBlock: ToolUseBlock = {
286	    ...toolUseBlock,
287	    input: finalInput,
288	  }
289	
290	  const canUseTool: CanUseToolFn = (async () => {
291	    if (permissionResult.behavior === 'allow') {
292	      return {
293	        behavior: 'allow' as const,
294	        updatedInput: (permissionResult as { updatedInput?: Record<string, unknown> }).updatedInput,
295	        decisionReason: {
296	          type: 'mode' as const,
297	          mode: 'default' as const,
298	        },
299	      }
300	    }
301	    return {
302	      behavior: 'deny' as const,
303	      message: (permissionResult as { message?: string }).message,
304	      decisionReason: {
305	        type: 'mode' as const,
306	        mode: 'default' as const,
307	      },
308	    }
309	  }) as CanUseToolFn
310	
311	  // Add the assistant message with tool_use to messages BEFORE executing
312	  // so the conversation history is complete (tool_use -> tool_result).
313	  //
314	  // On CCR resume, mutableMessages is seeded from the transcript and may already
315	  // contain this tool_use. Pushing again would make normalizeMessagesForAPI merge
316	  // same-ID assistants (concatenating content) and produce a duplicate tool_use
317	  // ID, which the API rejects with "tool_use ids must be unique".
318	  //
319	  // Check for the specific tool_use_id rather than message.id: streaming yields
320	  // each content block as a separate AssistantMessage sharing one message.id, so
321	  // a [text, tool_use] response lands as two entries. filterUnresolvedToolUses may
322	  // strip the tool_use entry but keep the text one; an id-based check would then
323	  // wrongly skip the push while runTools below still executes, orphaning the result.
324	  const alreadyPresent = mutableMessages.some(
325	    m =>
326	      m.type === 'assistant' &&
327	      Array.isArray(m.message.content) &&
328	      m.message.content.some(
329	        b => b.type === 'tool_use' && 'id' in b && b.id === toolUseID,
330	      ),
331	  )
332	  if (!alreadyPresent) {
333	    mutableMessages.push(assistantMessage)
334	    if (persistSession) {
335	      await recordTranscript(mutableMessages)
336	    }
337	  }
338	
339	  const sdkAssistantMessage: SDKMessage = {
340	    ...assistantMessage,
341	    session_id: getSessionId(),
342	    parent_tool_use_id: null,
343	  } as SDKMessage
344	  yield sdkAssistantMessage
345	
346	  // Execute the tool - errors are handled internally by runToolUse
347	  for await (const update of runTools(
348	    [finalToolUseBlock],
349	    [assistantMessage],
350	    canUseTool,
351	    processUserInputContext,
352	  )) {
353	    if (update.message) {
354	      mutableMessages.push(update.message)
355	      if (persistSession) {
356	        await recordTranscript(mutableMessages)
357	      }
358	
359	      const sdkMessage: SDKMessage = {
360	        ...update.message,
361	        session_id: getSessionId(),
362	        parent_tool_use_id: null,
363	      } as SDKMessage
364	
365	      yield sdkMessage
366	    }
367	  }
368	}

370	// Create a function to extract read files from messages
371	export function extractReadFilesFromMessages(
372	  messages: Message[],
373	  cwd: string,
374	  maxSize: number = ASK_READ_FILE_STATE_CACHE_SIZE,
375	): FileStateCache {
376	  const cache = createFileStateCacheWithSizeLimit(maxSize)
377	
378	  // First pass: find all FileReadTool/FileWriteTool/FileEditTool uses in assistant messages
379	  const fileReadToolUseIds = new Map<string, string>() // toolUseId -> filePath
380	  const fileWriteToolUseIds = new Map<
381	    string,
382	    { filePath: string; content: string }
383	  >() // toolUseId -> { filePath, content }
384	  const fileEditToolUseIds = new Map<string, string>() // toolUseId -> filePath
385	
386	  for (const message of messages) {
387	    if (
388	      message.type === 'assistant' &&
389	      Array.isArray(message.message.content)
390	    ) {
391	      for (const content of message.message.content) {
392	        if (
393	          content.type === 'tool_use' &&
394	          content.name === FILE_READ_TOOL_NAME
395	        ) {
396	          // Extract file_path from the tool use input
397	          const input = content.input as FileReadInput | undefined
398	          // Ranged reads are not added to the cache.
399	          if (
400	            input?.file_path &&
401	            input?.offset === undefined &&
402	            input?.limit === undefined
403	          ) {
404	            // Normalize to absolute path for consistent cache lookups
405	            const absolutePath = expandPath(input.file_path, cwd)
406	            fileReadToolUseIds.set(content.id, absolutePath)
407	          }
408	        } else if (
409	          content.type === 'tool_use' &&
410	          content.name === FILE_WRITE_TOOL_NAME
411	        ) {
412	          // Extract file_path and content from the Write tool use input
413	          const input = content.input as
414	            | { file_path?: string; content?: unknown }
415	            | undefined
416	          if (
417	            input?.file_path &&
418	            input.content !== undefined &&
419	            input.content !== null
420	          ) {
421	            // Normalize to absolute path for consistent cache lookups
422	            const absolutePath = expandPath(input.file_path, cwd)
423	            fileWriteToolUseIds.set(content.id, {
424	              filePath: absolutePath,
425	              content: coerceToolContentToString(input.content),
426	            })
427	          }
428	        } else if (
429	          content.type === 'tool_use' &&
430	          content.name === FILE_EDIT_TOOL_NAME
431	        ) {
432	          // Edit's input has old_string/new_string, not the resulting content.
433	          // Track the path so the second pass can read current disk state.
434	          const input = content.input as { file_path?: string } | undefined
435	          if (input?.file_path) {
436	            const absolutePath = expandPath(input.file_path, cwd)
437	            fileEditToolUseIds.set(content.id, absolutePath)
438	          }
439	        }
440	      }
441	    }
442	  }
443	
444	  // Second pass: find corresponding tool results and extract content
445	  for (const message of messages) {
446	    if (message.type === 'user' && Array.isArray(message.message.content)) {
447	      for (const content of message.message.content) {
448	        if (content.type === 'tool_result' && content.tool_use_id) {
449	          // Handle Read tool results
450	          const readFilePath = fileReadToolUseIds.get(content.tool_use_id)
451	          if (
452	            readFilePath &&
453	            typeof content.content === 'string' &&
454	            // Dedup stubs contain no file content — the earlier real Read
455	            // already cached it. Chronological last-wins would otherwise
456	            // overwrite the real entry with stub text.
457	            !content.content.startsWith(FILE_UNCHANGED_STUB)
458	          ) {
459	            // Remove system-reminder blocks from the content
460	            const processedContent = content.content.replace(
461	              /<system-reminder>[\s\S]*?<\/system-reminder>/g,
462	              '',
463	            )
464	
465	            // Extract the actual file content from the tool result
466	            // Tool results for text files contain line numbers, we need to strip those
467	            const fileContent = processedContent
468	              .split('\n')
469	              .map(stripLineNumberPrefix)
470	              .join('\n')
471	              .trim()
472	
473	            // Cache the file content with the message timestamp
474	            if (message.timestamp) {
475	              const timestamp = new Date(message.timestamp as string | number).getTime()
476	              cache.set(readFilePath, {
477	                content: fileContent,
478	                timestamp,
479	                offset: undefined,
480	                limit: undefined,
481	              })
482	            }
483	          }
484	
485	          // Handle Write tool results - use content from the tool input
486	          const writeToolData = fileWriteToolUseIds.get(content.tool_use_id)
487	          if (writeToolData && message.timestamp) {
